description: Measured prototype calibration from the supplied 30 ppm H2S series at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 30 minutes. The 5-15 minute samples overlap visually, so they are pooled into an intermediate 5 ppm·hr estimate instead of reporting false precision.

source.limitations: Single photographed series with no replicates and no cross-interference challenge. The series brackets the 3.75 ppm·hr STEL dose but does not calibrate the 80 ppm·hr full-shift dose. Use for prototype categorisation only.

expiry_valid_range.description: Fresh yellow FeSO4 reference tolerance after white balancing; the yellow-family gate must also pass.

points.note: pooled midpoint of visually overlapping 5-15 minute samples
30 ppm for 30 minutes; upper measured bound
